approved_decisions.D1: Use a2-enrichment-record.schema.json version 1.0.0-draft.1 as the Step 2D Unitalk proposal.
approved_decisions.D2: Require exactly the fourteen approved canonical sections in every record revision.
approved_decisions.D3: Apply additionalProperties false to every locally defined structural object.
approved_decisions.D4: Preserve the complete A1-to-A2 handoff through the approved external schema reference.
approved_decisions.D5: Use generic strict canonical-value shapes while leaving business value types, units and component keys to the separate Field Catalogue.
approved_decisions.D6: Reference the complete Step 2C signal, return and A1 score-revision schemas; A2 remains unable to calculate a score.
approved_decisions.D7: Keep HubSpot, Twenty, n8n, provider and downstream IDs nullable and connector-controlled; null does not prove a check or absence.
approved_decisions.D8: Enforce structural no-integration and approval ceilings in the schema without claiming integration readiness.
approved_decisions.D9: Keep business fields, minimum packages, source rules, confidence/freshness rules, protected fields, CRM mappings and retention outside the stable schema.
approved_decisions.D10: Assign cross-field integrity to the deterministic Step 2E validator and full business variants to the Step 2F regression suite.
